title: Xylem has a credible prototype; evidence and delivery will decide its submission

report.originalQuestion: How strong is the project for the Xylem hackathon, what issues remain, and what should we do before submission?

source.label: Saved demonstration and reconciled desktop exports
caveats: Modeled selected-system population, with overlap unresolved; not measured intervention benefit.
The reserve is a sequential priority rule, not a globally optimal reserve-constrained solution.

metricDefinitions.label: Modeled people
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of saved populations of selected systems; no person-level deduplication or causal benefit inference.

rows.nextAction: Existing repo admin enables Pages; verify exact source and served bytes.
Trace provenance and prepare a separately reviewed display-name correction; preserve model results.
Complete slides, 3–4 minute video, team/assistance fields and verify published project status.
Observe one planning task with a relevant reviewer; record critical feedback.

rows.finding: Annual and multi-year risk remain unvalidated
rows.nextAction: Keep claims diagnostic; do not retrain or claim prevention benefit for the deadline.

rows.finding: Physical phones and spoken AT remain untested
rows.nextAction: Test real phones, native text settings, speech and saved-file workflows after release gates.

source.label: Current release evidence, official rules, frozen scan and targeted browser observation
caveats: Priority is a recommended work order, not an official judging score.
No percentage probability of winning is estimated.
